text:
Learning to read the Quran is Fardh for every Muslim as the holy book contains the last message sent from Allah to mankind. Muslims have to recite different Surahs from the Quran during Salah which further emphasizes the importance of learning to read the holy book. However, there are different ways to read the Quran and for recitation, it is best to learn Tajweed rules. Let’s find out more about Tajweed and how you can sign up for a course to learn it from qualified teachers.
What is Tajweed?
Every Muslim learns a few Tajweed rules when they are taught to read the Quran. However, reciting the Quran is different from simply reading it and requires the reciter to be familiar with all Tajweed rules. Tajweed refers to a set of rules that govern the way in which Quranic words are pronounced during recitation. The rules of Tajweed are based on the Quranic recitations of the Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.). By learning to recite the Quran with Tajweed, Muslims can contribute towards maintaining the integrity of religion.
Learning Tajweed
Muslims can learn the rules of Tajweed in a number of ways. Most people turn to local Quran institutions or Madrassahs to learn Quran recitation with Tajweed. Scholars who have complete knowledge of Tajweed and can recite the Quran accurately themselves teach it to students in Quran institutes. For those who wish to learn Tajweed but don’t have any Quran institute in their city, joining an online course is the best option.
